hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western South America, bordering the Pacific Ocean at the Equator, between Colombia and Peru || coastal plain (costa), inter-Andean central highlands (sierra), and flat to rolling eastern jungle (oriente) || Cotopaxi in the Andes is highest active volcano in world || Resources: petroleum, fish, timber, hydropower || Exports: crude petroleum, shellfish, bananas, fish, gold (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: coastal plain (costa), inter-Andean central highlands (sierra), and flat to rolling eastern jungle (oriente) || Western South America, bordering the Pacific Ocean at the Equator, between Colombia and Peru

climate.excerpt: tropical along coast, becoming cooler inland at higher elevations; tropical in Amazonian jungle lowlands || frequent earthquakes; landslides; volcanic activity; floods; periodic droughts volcanism: volcanic activity concentrated along the Andes Mountains; Sangay (5,230 m) is mainland Ecuador's most active volcano; other historically active volcanoes in the Andes include Antisana, Cayambe, Chacana, Cotopaxi, Guagua Pichincha, Reventador, Sumaco, and Tungurahua; Fernandina (1,476 m), a shield volcano, is the most active of the many Galapagos volcanoes; other historically active Galapagos volcanoes include Wolf, Sierra Negra, Cerro Azul, Pinta, Marchena, and Santiago

economy.excerpt: highly informal South American economy; USD currency user; major banana exporter; hard hit by COVID-19; macroeconomic fragility from oil dependency; successful debt restructuring; China funding budget deficits; social unrest hampering economic activity || Exports: crude petroleum, shellfish, bananas, fish, gold (2023) || Industries: petroleum, food processing, textiles, wood products, chemicals
